Narrative Report, Dedication, Acknowledgement & Reflections

Presented to the Faculty of the College of Information Technology Education, North Eastern Mindanao State University – Tandag Campus, in partial fulfillment of On-The-Job Training in Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (June–August 2026).

Pages 1–2 • Narrative Report

Introduction to My OJT Journey

On-the-Job Training (OJT) is an essential component of a student's academic journey as it provides an opportunity to gain practical experience and prepare for future professional careers. It allows students to extend their learning beyond the classroom and immerse themselves in an actual work environment where they can apply the knowledge, skills, and principles they have acquired throughout their studies. Through this experience, students are able to understand the realities of the workplace, become familiar with professional responsibilities, and contribute their knowledge and skills to the organization where they are assigned.

Beyond developing technical skills, OJT also provides students with opportunities to establish professional relationships and build meaningful connections with colleagues and other professionals. Working alongside individuals with different experiences and areas of expertise allows students to learn from others, improve their communication and interpersonal skills, and gain insights into the expectations and challenges of their chosen profession. The relationships formed during the training may also serve as valuable professional networks that can provide guidance and opportunities in the future.

My OJT experience at the NEMSU Information Unit has been both insightful and meaningful. Throughout the training, I gained a better understanding of how professional workplaces operate and how the knowledge I acquired as a Computer Science student can be applied to actual tasks and responsibilities. More importantly, I learned valuable lessons from my colleagues and fellow trainees that extend beyond technical knowledge. Their experiences and advice helped me become more aware of the skills, attitude, professionalism, and connections that I need to develop as I approach the end of my college journey and prepare to enter the workforce.

Overall, this OJT has been an important learning experience that has contributed not only to my academic and professional development, but also to my personal growth. It has given me a clearer perspective on the responsibilities and expectations of working in a professional environment and has helped me become more prepared for the opportunities and challenges that await me after graduation.

Pages 27–28 • After Completion of the Training

Personal & Professional Reflection

My On-the-Job Training journey at the NEMSU Information Unit has been a meaningful and valuable experience that allowed me to apply the knowledge and skills I have gained as a Computer Science student. Throughout the training, I was exposed to different tasks and responsibilities that helped me understand how the knowledge learned in the classroom can be applied in an actual workplace. From learning to document events to assisting with publication materials and other office-related activities, I gained a better understanding of the importance of technical knowledge, adaptability, and attention to detail. These experiences also helped me appreciate the value of continuous learning and the need to remain open to new challenges.

Beyond the technical skills I developed, my OJT also taught me important lessons about professionalism, teamwork, and responsibility. Working with my supervisors, colleagues, and my fellow trainee allowed me to learn from their experiences and understand the expectations of a professional work environment. I realized that completing tasks is not only about having the necessary skills, but also about being patient, cooperative, willing to ask questions, and committed to producing quality work. The challenges I encountered helped me become more confident in handling unfamiliar tasks and reminded me that mistakes and difficulties are part of the learning process. The friendships and connections I formed during the training also made the experience more enjoyable and gave me valuable insights into the attitudes and skills I need to develop as I prepare for my future career.

Overall, my OJT journey has helped me grow not only as a Computer Science student but also as an individual. It gave me a clearer perspective on the realities of the workplace and helped me recognize the importance of preparing myself for the responsibilities that come after. The knowledge, experiences, and lessons I gained will serve as a foundation as I continue my studies and work toward my professional goals. I am grateful for the opportunity to learn, contribute, and experience the working environment at NEMSU. This training has strengthened my determination to continue improving my skills, embrace future challenges, and become a more capable and responsible professional.

North Eastern Mindanao State University (NEMSU)

Rosario, Tandag City, Surigao del Sur, 8300 • Deployed at the NEMSU Information Office / Information Unit under the Chief Administrative Office (CAO).

Philosophy

Higher education is an instrument for the improvement of life through democratized access to quality education that accelerates human capital development.

Vision

Higher education is an instrument for the improvement of life through democratized access to quality education that accelerates human capital development.

Mission

We drive sustainable development through quality instruction, innovative research, community collaboration, and technological advancement.

Five Institutional Goals

1. Instruction

Drive inclusive education that prioritizes student success, fosters global connectivity, elevates academic standards, and innovates for sustainability and cultural promotion in Surigao del Sur.

2. Research

Produce high-impact research through strong collaborations to maximize global visibility and impactful utilization that propel advancements across knowledge, instructional innovation, institutional development, policy formulation, and commercialization.

3. Extension

Improve the lives of the rural and urban poor through transfer of technology and knowledge.

4. Production

Optimize resource generation to ensure sustained operations and continuous improvement of university services.

5. Governance

Establish a client-centric, transparent, and efficient governance, and integrate modernized, disaster-resilient physical and digital infrastructure and facilities to ensure robustness and adaptability.

NEMSU Core Values (C.A.R.E.S.)

C — Compassion

Entails the value of promoting empathy, sincerity, and authenticity within the academic community to foster a caring and supportive environment where individuals feel understood, valued, and respected.

A — Accountability

Signifies unwavering commitment to integrity, honesty, and transparent practices, coupled with a sense of responsibility for actions and decisions, ensuring ethical, efficient, and cost-effective stewardship of resources for the common good.

R — Responsiveness

Prompt action and release of consistent quality communication that is focused on providing correct and complete action and/or information to clients and stakeholders.

E — Excellence

The consistent pursuit of the highest standards of performance, characterized by innovation, dedication, and impactful contributions across all aspects of endeavor.

S — Service

The embodiment of professionalism, dedication, a service-oriented mindset, commitment to excellence, integrity, and continual improvement while fostering interdependence, collaboration, and sustainable success within the community and nation-building endeavors.
